entity_raw.definition_raw: Deception SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): TrickeryAssociated Deities: Achaekek, Aksha, Alichino, Andirifkhu, Areshkagal, Aroggus, Asmodeus, Bastet, Besmara, Braismois, Bundha, Caera, Calistria, Camazotz, Chimon, Chupurvagasti, Corosbel, Dachzerul, Dahak, Dispater, Dradjit, Droskar, Erecura, Folca, Gavidya, Hudima, Isph-Aun-Vuln, Jezelda, Jyotah, Khepri, Kro'akoth, Kunkarna, Laivatiniel, Lamashtu, Lorthact, Mahathallah, Mestama, Muronna, Mursha, Nalmungder, Nivi Rhombodazzle, Norgorber, Nyarlathotep (Black Pharaoh), Otikaya, Pazuzu, Picoperi, Prihasta, Ravana, Scarmiglione, Sifkesh, Sivanah, Skrymir, Sun Wukong, Surpa, The Lantern King, Titivilus, Ulon, Verex, Vibhishah, Xhamen-Dor, Yaezhing, ZabhaReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the copycat power of the Trickery domain. Sudden Shift (Sp): In the blink of an eye, you can appear somewhere else. As an immediate action, after you are missed by a melee attack, you can teleport up to 10 feet to a space that you can see. This space must be inside the reach of the creature that attacked you. You can use this power a number of times each day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—mirror image, 7th—project image.
